name: Political instability
summary: US votes in midterms; French general strike set for 5 Nov
state: No G20 government has fallen and no coup was reported as of 3 Nov. The US holds midterm elections on 3 Nov, and French unions have called a general strike for 5 Nov after about 410,000 marched on 31 Oct (Latin Times). Israel's governing coalition lost its majority in elections the previous week (AP), but Israel is not in the G20.
for_you: Expect travel disruption in France on 5 Nov; check FCDO advice.
rubric_hit: No G20 collapse, contested election or coup

sources.title: Latin Times — France protests: unions set 5 Nov general strike

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
